reviewNotes: Twenty-five book-of-power strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover playful book titles, defense and speed bonuses, probability wording, Mystery Boxes, the Queen of Sauce, fishing treasure, item recovery, trash, monster loot, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

Book_Diamonds_Description.source: All stones have a chance to drop a diamond when mined by hand.
Book_Diamonds_Description.translation: Orice piatră are șansa de a da un diamant când o spargi tu.

Book_Friendship_Description.source: You become friends with people a little faster.
Book_Friendship_Description.translation: Te împrietenești puțin mai repede cu oamenii.

Book_Marlon_Description.source: You get a 50% discount on Marlon's item retrieval service.
Book_Marlon_Description.translation: Primești o reducere de 50% la serviciul lui Marlon de recuperare a obiectelor.

Book_Mystery_Description.source: You have a slightly greater chance to find Mystery Boxes.
Book_Mystery_Description.translation: Ai o șansă puțin mai mare să găsești Cutii misterioase.

Book_PriceCatalogue_Description.source: You can now see the value of your items.
Book_PriceCatalogue_Description.translation: Acum poți vedea valoarea obiectelor tale.

Book_QueenOfSauce_Name.translation: Cartea de bucate a Reginei Sosului

Book_QueenOfSauce_Description.source: Learn any Queen Of Sauce recipes that you don't already know.
Book_QueenOfSauce_Description.translation: Înveți orice rețetă de la Regina Sosului pe care nu o cunoști deja.

Book_Riding_Description.source: You gain a little extra speed when riding a horse.
Book_Riding_Description.translation: Te deplasezi puțin mai repede când călărești.

Book_Roe_Description.source: Fishing treasure chests have a chance to yield roe.
Book_Roe_Description.translation: Cuferele cu comori de la pescuit pot conține icre.

Book_Speed_Description.source: You run a little bit faster.

Book_Speed2_Description.source: You run a little bit faster.

Book_Trash_Description.source: You have a greater chance to find items in the trash.
Book_Trash_Description.translation: Ai o șansă mai mare să găsești obiecte în gunoi.

Book_Void_Description.source: Monsters have a small chance to drop double loot.
Book_Void_Description.translation: Monștrii au o mică șansă să lase pradă dublă.
